name: Trade Repository Reporting Type 1 Code
definition: Indication whether both counterparties to the transaction have reported to the same trade repository or each counterparty to the transaction reported two different trade repository.

SWOS.name: Single Sided
SWOS.definition: Only one counterparty to the transaction has reported to the same trade repository.

TWOS.name: Dual Sided
TWOS.definition: Both counterparties to the transaction have reported to the same trade repository.
